name: AgentErrorTaxonomy
representation_policy: Canonical paper categories with module, category name, and source definition only; implementation examples are omitted for information-content parity with AgentRx.

categories.name: over_simplification
categories.definition: Agent oversimplifies complex information from previous N steps, ignoring details and key factors, leading to decisions based on partial or oversimplified summaries

categories.name: memory_retrieval_failure
categories.definition: Relevant information exists in agent memory but fails to be retrieved when needed

categories.name: hallucination
categories.definition: Agent "recalls" events that never happened, object states never observed, or actions never executed, and uses these as basis for reasoning. Agent fills in missing parts without solid memory basis, generating false memory information

categories.name: progress_misjudge
categories.definition: Agent incorrectly evaluates progress toward completing the overall task goal, being either overly optimistic or pessimistic

categories.name: outcome_misinterpretation
categories.definition: Agent correctly executes an action but incorrectly interprets the direct result or environment feedback from that action

categories.name: causal_misattribution
categories.definition: Agent correctly identifies a failure phenomenon but attributes it to the wrong cause

categories.name: constraint_ignorance
categories.definition: Planning ignores task constraints, not considering resource limits (time, budget, space) or other relevant restrictions

categories.name: impossible_action
categories.definition: Agent plans to execute an action or subtask that is fundamentally impossible under current physical or logical conditions. May include decomposition problems

categories.name: inefficient_plan
categories.definition: Agent creates plan that can theoretically complete task but is extremely inefficient, lengthy, or illogical

categories.name: misalignment
categories.definition: Generated specific action completely contradicts the intention stated in current plan module (wrong action choice)

categories.name: invalid_action
categories.definition: Uses action that does not exist

categories.name: format_error
categories.definition: Generated action has invalid format causing parse failure

categories.name: parameter_error
categories.definition: Action parameters are unreasonable or incorrectly chosen

categories.name: step_limit
categories.definition: Agent executes reasonably but fails due to reaching system maximum step limit

categories.name: tool_execution_error
categories.definition: External tool or API called by agent returns error or exhibits unpredictable behavior

categories.name: environment_error
categories.definition: Simulation environment itself has bugs, network issues cause unexpected behavior against expected rules

excluded_implementation_entries.reason: Present in error_definitions.py but absent from the repository's canonical 17-type README table; the paper taxonomy counts hallucination under memory.
Implementation fallback category, not one of the 17 paper taxonomy types.
